1.description: [Pending Restart] - [Dragon Warrior] - Dragon Roar now reduces the damage when hitting 5 or more targets. It now functions similarly to Stormborn and Pure Shadow, hitting 5 targets will result in 5 hits, each hit being equal to the damage it would deal to a single target. The total damage past 5 targets will be increased by half a target for every target added. This means that when hitting 10 targets, your Dragon Roar will deal 7.5 targets worth of damage, each hit of the 10 targets being hit equal to 75% of what it would have done to a singular target. Hitting more than 10 targets does not increase the overall damage done from Dragon Roar, this is unchanged.

Fixed a tooltip issue on Serpent Form where an incorrect tooltip from an earlier iteration was pushed. This fix is purely visual and clarifies how the mechanics are currently working right now and will not affect your Serpent form gameplay. Clarified that Serpent Form causes your auto attacks to deal bonus nature damage and removed incorrect information about Serpent Form granting stat conversions. Clarified that Venomous Fury also deals damage in a cone in front of you. (Pending Spell Patch Update)

6.description: [Karazhan] [Prince Malchezaar] Prince Malchezaars Axes, Infernals, their target visual and all visuals associated to Doom cast are now active and visible inside the Shadow Realm on Mythic and higher difficulty when Prince Malchezaar enters phase three and shatters reality.

[Karazhan] [Prince Malchezaar] Prince Malchezaar now summons two Axes on higher player counts instead of pair when phase three starts.

He now casts Hack and Slash, attacking with both weapons for 50% Weapon damage each, sundering the targets armor with the main-hand and cleaves enemies in-front of him with the off-hand. He than starts a vicious assault increasing his attack speed by 100% for 8 seconds.
[Karazhan] [Prince Malchezaar] Enfeeble now restores the effected player to maximum health when removed.
[Karazhan] [Netherspite] [Netherspite] Greatly reduced fps lag generated during the Netherspite encounter.

[Karazhan] [Netherspite] [Netherspite] The Nether Portal - Entropy (Black) stacking buff, Nether Infusion - Entropy, now reduces Shadow damage taken by 1% down from 2% and increases scale by 1% down from 2% per stack. Nether Infusion - Entropy now stacks up to 99 times up from 49.

[Karazhan] [Netherspite] [Netherspite] The Nether Portal - Domination (Blue) stacking buff, Nether Infusion - Domination, now increases damage dealt by 1% down from 2%, magic damage taken by 1% down from 2%, and movement speed by 1% down from 2% per stack. Nether Infusion - Domination, both the player and the buff applied to Netherspite now stacks up to 99 times up from 49.

[Karazhan] [Netherspite] [Netherspite] The Nether Portal - Domination (Blue) stacking buff, Nether Infusion - Domination, now increases damage dealt by 1% down from 2%, magic damage taken by 1% down from 2%, and movement speed by 1% down from 2% per stack. Nether Infusion - Domination, both the player and the buff applied to Netherspite now stacks up to 99 times up from 49.

[Karazhan] [Netherspite] The Nether Portal - Serenity (Green) stacking buff, Nether Infusion - Serenity, now heals Netherspite for 0.01% of his maximum health per second, per stack. Previously would heal for a fix amount.

[Karazhan] [Netherspite] The Nether Portal - Serenity (Green) stacking buff, Nether Infusion - Serenity, now increases all healing done by 1% down from 2%, mana costs by 1% down from 2%, and maximum mana by 1%, changed from a fix value per stack. [Karazhan] [Netherspite] The Nether Portal - Perseverance (Red) stacking buff, Nether Infusion - Perseverance, now reduces damage taken by 1% down from 2%, scale by 1% down from 2%, and health by 1%, changed from a fix value per stack. [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Shade of Aran will no longer evade when a player is outside the room or gets to close to the room door. He instead now teleports all player outside his room to his position.
[Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Removed periodically appearing Arcane Rift explosions before the Arcane Rift spiral begins moving at the rooms edges.
[Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Arcane Rifts now reach every corner of the room.

Arcane Rifts now inflict 10 to 30% maximum health damage depending on the raids difficulty down from 48%. Arcane Rifts once again destroy all forms of absorption. [Karazhan] [Shade of Aran] Enchanted Water Elementals Water Bolt no longer reduce their targets movement speed.
